widget.name: Recursive Container
widget.description: Renders a widget tree recursively by following a self-referencing association. Use this widget to display tree structures of unlimited depth.

property.caption: Content
property.description: The widgets to render for each node in the tree. The context object is the current tree node.

property.caption: Child object
property.description: A datasource that resolves to the child object via a self-referencing association (e.g. TreeNode_Parent/TreeNode). Leave empty to stop recursion at this node.

property.caption: Child content
property.description: Drop another Recursive Container here to render the child node. This slot is rendered in the context of the child object.

property.caption: Max depth
property.description: Maximum number of recursion levels to prevent infinite loops. Default is 25.
